verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Phoenix is free to self-host, keeps data entirely within your own infrastructure, sends nothing to Arize, and can be fully air-gapped. That gives users ownership of where data lives, and implicitly of how long it is kept, but the pack documents no retention or deletion controls. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies (TTL/auto-purge), trace/span/dataset deletion via UI or API, documented deletion guarantees for any hosted offering, and independent corroboration.
